svg.title: GuitarDAWLiteOS codec and clock sheet (ADC-as-master, bench modules)
svg.desc: Pi 5 J8 header as I2S slave, CJMCU-1808 breakout as bus master clocked by a Nano ESP32 MCLK, and GY-PCM5102 DAC, with every pin assigned to a net and its drive direction. Nets joined by name.

GY-PCM5102 · U3
VIN <- +5VGND . GNDSCK . GND (int. PLL)BCK <- BCLKLCK <- LRCLKDIN <- PLAYDATFLT pad . LDEMP pad . LXSMT pad . H (unmute!)FMT pad . LOUT L/R/G -> line out
Notes
Nets joined by name: MCLK · BCLK · LRCLK · CAPDAT · PLAYDAT · +5V · +3V3 · GND.
Arrow = who drives the net; "." = strap / tie / no-connect.
One clock domain, rooted at the Nano's crystal: the ADC divides MCLK by 256 → 48 kHz
LRCLK and by 4 → 3.072 MHz BCLK — everyone else follows.
Power: Pi p2/p1 feed the ADC's two rails; DAC VIN from +5V; the TL072 front-end
runs on its own 9 V domain (separate sheet).
STAR GND at Pi p6: ADC GND + "–" pad, DAC GND, Nano GND, CopperSound rail —
one point, no ground islands.
Rev-A KiCad HAT sheet (Pi-as-master, on-HAT bare chips) predates the clock pivot;
this sheet is the as-built bench truth.
